Thanks Elena — love the clarity on outcomes. Quick thoughts and a compact approach so we can keep it high-value for your execs:

Proposed format (45 min total):
- 5 min: quick kickoff & goals (customer execs)
- 20 min: targeted roadmap walkthrough (features + expected impact)
- 15 min: live demo of the three items you listed (performance + cost controls)
- 5 min: decisions & next steps (+ confirm follow-ups)

Slot options (PT) — these are optimized for a compact format and a 10-min stakeholder buffer at the end for handoffs:
1) Tue Mar 7, 10:00–10:45 PT (we'll leave 10:45–10:55 as buffer)
2) Wed Mar 8, 08:30–09:15 PT
3) Thu Mar 9, 13:00–13:45 PT

Pre-demo checklist (short):
- Confirm tech attendee (one engineer with access to logs for a quick question)
- Share 2–3 priority goals you want impacted by Q3 roadmap
- Any compliance/region constraints to highlight now

I've looped in Vivek (customer success lead for the account) and Marcus (solutions engineering) so they can confirm availability for the chosen slot and the technical segment.

I'll attach a compact agenda and a draft SOW for the renewal so you have context: QBR_agenda_v2.pdf, SOW_draft.docx (will follow in calendar invite).

Thanks — happy to be flexible if your stakeholders need a slightly different window.

Best,
